objects.name: Temperature Routing
objects.one_liner: Universal routing signal: COOL/WARM/HOT (NEUTRAL for baseline tokens).
objects.description: Controls pacing, access, and allowable operations. HOT is gated and downshifts under drift.
constraints: HOT is gated; auto-downshift HOT→WARM→COOL under instability.

objects.name: KayOS Dimension Cap
objects.one_liner: Tiered access: T1 WHAT/WHEN/WHERE; T2 +WHO/HOW; T3 +WHICH (temporary); T4 WHY (write-only).
objects.description: Runtime prevents WHY authority; WHY permitted only as post-hoc residue/archival note.
constraints: DIM=T4 is never used for runtime steering.

objects.name: Drift Buckets A–E
objects.one_liner: Counts-based drift triggers for automated downshift and quarantine.
objects.description: A=Heat instability/TLB; B=Identity capture; C=Meaning capture/WHY authority; D=Consent+dominance drift; E=Coupling contagion.
constraints: Severity computed from count density (thermometer), not moderator judgment.

objects.name: Closure Codes (11/0/12)
objects.one_liner: 11=quarantine/lock; 0=baseline; 12=complete closure.
objects.description: Symbol hygiene codepath for fragmentation detection and closure enforcement.
constraints: Any session must end with DONE12 or LOCK11; no open-ended drift.

objects.name: TE-1 Airlock State
objects.one_liner: Threshold Engineering: CHECK/PASS/RESET states for consent+state alignment.
objects.description: Prevents unconsented heat and enforces dimensional caps at entry and reset.
constraints: If instability detected → TE1=RESET; DIM=T1; TEMP=WARM.

objects.name: TLB Packetization
objects.one_liner: Packet size/cadence/hotcap routing for temporal load balancing.
objects.description: Controls packet duration and rate; auto-reduces under drift; enforces HOTCAP gating.
constraints: Under drift, PKT and RATE decrease; HOTCAP tightened.

objects.name: FSP Ladder Level
objects.one_liner: Failsafe Stability Protocol level L0–L5 (automatic response ladder).
objects.description: Downshift ladder that collapses temperature, dimensions, packet size, and topology to restore stability.
constraints: No manual override by status/funding/tenure; equal application.

objects.name: Topology / Coupling
objects.one_liner: Active pod topology and coupling constraints (1/3/6/12 etc).
objects.description: Controls group size and coupling modes; collapses under drift via FSP.
constraints: Topology downshifts under instability; bridge sealing where required.

objects.name: Commons Arena Protocol Mode
objects.one_liner: CAP modes: MEMBRANE / QUARANTINE / PROMOTE0–5 routing.
objects.description: Controls artifact propagation permissions and quarantine rules.
constraints: Promotion requires receipts; quarantine locks narrative residue.

objects.name: Janus Keyhole (WHY non-addressable)
objects.one_liner: WHY is write-only residue; never runtime authority or steering input.
objects.description: Meaning may appear only as post-action residue; if it becomes steering authority it is demoted to narrative and quarantined.
constraints: No runtime WHY answers; demote meaning-as-authority to LOCK11.

objects.name: TE-1 Threshold Engineering
objects.one_liner: Consent + state airlock before any session or escalation.
objects.description: Enforces entry checks, sets dim caps, prevents unconsented heat; provides reset path.
constraints: On destabilization: TE1=RESET; DIM=T1; TEMP=WARM; CLOSE=REQ12.

objects.name: Temporal Load Balancing
objects.one_liner: Packetizes time/complexity to prevent overload and spectacle.
objects.description: Constrains packet size and cadence; auto-cuts under drift; enforces HOTCAP.
constraints: DRIFT↑ => RATE↓, PKT↓, HOTCAP tightened.

objects.name: Failsafe Stability Protocol (FSP-1)
objects.one_liner: Automatic response ladder L0–L5 for drift buckets A–E.
objects.description: Transforms social friction into technical cooling: downshift temperature, collapse dimensions, packetize time, downshift topology, enforce closure.
constraints: Count-based severity; no punitive moderation; equal application.

objects.name: Symbol Hygiene 11/0/12
objects.one_liner: Detect split (11), return baseline (0), enforce closure (12).
objects.description: Cross-cutting drift detection and closure enforcement.
constraints: Fragmentation triggers downshift and closure requirement.

objects.name: Commons Arena Protocol (CAP)
objects.one_liner: Membrane rules for artifact sharing: credit without authority; promote only via receipts.
objects.description: Artifact propagation protocol with membrane rules, temperature gating, downshifts, and promotion pipeline.
constraints: No identity/doctrine propagation; quarantine narrative residue.

objects.name: R12 Closure Receipt
objects.one_liner: Proof-of-integrity record of a closed session (Artifact or Null).
objects.description: Logs temp peak, dim cap, topology, drift counts, checklist completion, and custody commit id. No content required.
constraints: Container integrity only; content optional; 'Artifact or Null' allowed.

objects.name: DONE12 Completion Signal
objects.one_liner: Closure code indicating complete session finish (12).
objects.description: Marks a session as fully closed with required checklist satisfied and custodian commit.
constraints: Required for promotion gates; absence forces REQ12 or LOCK11.

objects.name: LOCK11 Quarantine Signal
objects.one_liner: Closure code indicating quarantine/lock (11).
objects.description: Narrative residue archived/locked; procedural fragments may be salvaged via recovery path.
constraints: Locks identity/meaning capture residue; prohibits promotion of narrative.
